attacks_executed.attack: concurrency — two rapid execute_publication calls to same branch with different content
attacks_executed.result: Lock serializes access. Second call acquires lock after first releases. Content mismatch triggers new publication (not idempotent replay). Both succeed.

attacks_executed.attack: contention — lock file already held by another fcntl in same process
attacks_executed.result: LOCK_NB raises BlockingIOError. Context manager sets acquired=False. Service returns CONCURRENT_PUBLICATION_CONFLICT refusal. Lock FD cleaned up.

attacks_executed.attack: recovery — crash after commit but before ref update
attacks_executed.result: Orphaned commit detected. Receipt stores orphaned_commit_sha. Recovery path re-reads ledger, finds orphaned commit, returns CONTENT_COMMIT_CREATED_REF_NOT_UPDATED phase.

attacks_executed.result: Context manager closes FD in finally. No FD leak. Lock files accumulated but cleaned on next execution.

hostile_pass_results.strongest_surviving_weakness: If GitHubAuthorizationConsumerAdapter returns a dict missing the 'authorized' key (malformed adapter), _authorize_publication will default authorized=False via .get('authorized', False). This is fail-closed but the error is caught at the authorization gate, not the adapter boundary. A typed return (AuthorizationResult model) would catch malformed returns at type-check time.

consumption_handoff_x0.consumer_guidance: Call build_publication_projection with the path to the project's evidence ledger JSONL file, plus owner/repo/branch identity. The returned PublicationStatusContract is a content-light projection — no raw evidence ledger rows. The evidence_linkage field provides terminal_receipt_digest, evidence_ledger_path, and projection_digest for verification by downstream consumers.
contract_fields_x0_safe: transition_phase — current publication state (prepared, content_published, pages_configured, etc.)
content_published — boolean, truthfully reports whether content is published
pages_configured — boolean, truthfully reports whether Pages is configured
published_commit_sha — git commit SHA if published
site_url — GitHub Pages URL if configured
terminal_receipt_digest — sha256 digest of the terminal evidence receipt
projection_digest — sha256 digest of the projection itself
evidence_linkage — dict with terminal_receipt_digest, evidence_ledger_path, projection_digest
available_actions — list of actions available at current state
recovery_required — boolean indicating if recovery is needed
contract_fields_restricted: refusal_code, refusal_reasons — present only on REFUSED phase; never raw evidence
consumption_handoff_x0.usage_pattern: X0 frontend calls build_publication_projection on a timer or on-demand to refresh publication status display. The projection is a snapshot at read time — concurrent publications may update the ledger between reads. X0 should treat the projection as eventually-consistent.

out_of_scope_findings_recorded.description: fcntl advisory locks are process-local. Two separate Python processes won't share locks unless they access the exact same lock file path. Multi-process publication safety requires IPC-level lock or file-level mandatory locking.
out_of_scope_findings_recorded.recommended_slice: X3.9: Cross-process publication serialization with file-lock verification or IPC lock manager. Integration test with subprocess.
